 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Kuldeep Mathur
 Order

This second application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with FIR No.56/2023 registered at Police Station Shribalaji, District Nagaur, for offences under Sections 457, 376 IPC.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner is an innocent lady who has been falsely implicated in the present case.

Learned counsel submitted that the petitioner is having some matrimonial disputes with her husband and therefore, her daughter under the influence of her husband, has levelled false allegations of sending co-accused Moda Ram to his room, who allegedly committed sexual assault upon the prosecutrix.

Attention of the Court was drawn towards an application submitted by the prosecutrix before this Court stating inter-alia that owing to some misunderstanding, she has lodged [2023:RJ-JD:35841] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-11822/2023] the FIR against the present petitioner.
However, now she does not want to pursue the criminal proceedings against her mother and therefore, has no objection if the petitioner is enlarged on bail.

sentences.text:
Learned counsel submitted that charge-sheet against the petitioner has already been filed and thus,
the investigation against her is complete and there is no apprehension of the prosecutrix being influenced by the petitioner.
On these grounds, learned counsel thus, prayed that the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for the complainant have vehemently opposed the bail application.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.

Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case so also the fact that charge-sheet against the petitioner has already been filed and the prosecutrix herself has filed an application before this Court stating that owing to some misunderstanding, she had lodged the FIR against the present petitioner; the prosecution has not shown any apprehension of the prosecutrix being influenced by the petitioner, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case,
this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the second bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner- Smt. Dhapu W/o Hanuman Ram shall be enlarged on bail in connection with FIR No.56/2023 registered at Police Station Shribalaji, District Nagaur, provided she furnishes a personal bond [2023:RJ-JD:35841] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-11822/2023] in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for her appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to so.
It is however, made clear that findings recorded/observations made above are for limited purposes of adjudication of bail application.
The trial court shall not get prejudiced by the same.
